summary: BCHCTL00 is a callable Batch Control Processor that manages job control records in an indexed control file. It is invoked with a control request carrying a 4-char function code and dispatches to one of four flows: INIT (open files, read/validate the control record, mark the job started), CHEK (read the control record, check prerequisite dependencies, return success or warning), UPDT (read, update and write the process status), or TERM (mark completion, close files). Any unknown function returns an error via ERRPROC. NOTE: this is a SKELETON — the low-level sub-paragraphs it PERFORMs (1100-OPEN-FILES, 1200-READ-CONTROL-RECORD, etc.) are listed in comments as 'to be implemented' and are NOT defined in the source, so most flows currently do nothing.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SELECT CASE function (LS-FUNCTION)
  WHEN 'INIT': SET mode=Initialize; CALL 1000-PROCESS-INITIALIZE
  WHEN 'CHEK': SET mode=Check;      CALL 2000-CHECK-PREREQUISITES
  WHEN 'UPDT': SET mode=Update;     CALL 3000-UPDATE-STATUS
  WHEN 'TERM': SET mode=Finalize;   CALL 4000-PROCESS-TERMINATE
  ELSE: SET error 'Invalid function code'; CALL 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
END SELECT
SET job RETURN-CODE = LS-RETURN-CODE
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)

annotations.note: Called as a sub-routine (PROCEDURE DIVISION USING LS-CONTROL-REQUEST) — a job-control service invoked by other batch jobs.
SME REVIEW: all four PERFORM targets (1100/1200/1300/1400) are undefined in the source — listed only in a trailing comment as 'to be implemented'. This flow is a stub.

paragraphs.name: 2000-CHECK-PREREQUISITES
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 2100-READ-CONTROL-RECORD
CALL 2200-CHECK-DEPENDENCIES
IF prerequisites satisfied THEN
  SET LS-RETURN-CODE = success
ELSE
  SET LS-RETURN-CODE = warning
END IF

annotations.note: 2100/2200 are undefined stubs — PREREQS-SATISFIED is never actually set, so this always returns warning.

paragraphs.name: 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
SET ERR-PROGRAM = 'BCHCTL00'
SET LS-RETURN-CODE = error
CALL 'ERRPROC' PASSING ERR-MESSAGE   -- central error logger
